saturnus is a headless, clean-room emulator of the HP Saturn calculators,
written in Rust: a library first, with a command-line tool, a web page
and a desktop app on top. This is its first public release.

## The calculators

| Model | State |
| --- | --- |
| HP 48SX | boots, screens match the saturnng emulator, Kermit, real-hardware speed |
| HP 48GX | boots, screens match, Kermit, real-hardware speed |
| HP 49G | boots, screens match, Kermit, real-hardware speed (ROM 2.10 benchmark) |
| HP 38G | boots to HOME, takes keys |
| HP 39G | boots to HOME, takes keys, reset chords |
| HP 40G | as the 39G (same ROM), with its CAS key |
| HP 42S | boots, takes keys, runs its self-test |

## Get it

- **Web page**, nothing to install: <https://ractive.ch/saturnus/>.
  The ROM you pick stays in your browser; nothing is uploaded. On a
  phone it can be added to the home screen and then works offline. The
  calculator keeps its state across reloads ("Start fresh" in the palette
  for an empty one).
- **Command line** `saturnus`: `cargo install saturnus-cli`, or
  `brew install ractive/tap/saturnus` (macOS, Linux; Homebrew 6+ first
  `brew trust --formula ractive/tap/saturnus`), or
  `scoop bucket add ractive https://github.com/ractive/scoop-bucket`
  then `scoop install saturnus` (Windows), or an archive below
  (`saturnus-v0.1.0-<target>`; checksums in `SHA256SUMS`).
- **Desktop app**: the installers below, `.dmg` (macOS, Apple silicon),
  `.msi` or `-setup.exe` (Windows x86_64), `.deb`, `.rpm` or `.AppImage`
  (Linux x86_64). The same page, with the core running natively; an
  empty ROM slot offers to download the image from hpcalc.org.
- **Libraries** on crates.io: `saturnus` (the core: no dependencies,
  builds for `wasm32`), `saturnus-objects`, `saturnus-host`,
  `saturnus-drive`.

## What you can do with it

- **Type and edit** (48SX, 48GX, 49G): paste text, or pick a command in
  the palette (Cmd/Ctrl+K), and it is typed into the calculator's
  command line. The palette's editor opens a variable, a stack level or
  the command line as RPL text; Cmd/Ctrl+S sends it back, and the
  calculator compiles it. Cmd/Ctrl+E opens the selected object.
- **Memory view** (48SX, 48GX, 49G): variables, directories, stack and
  flags, read live. Store a file by dropping it on the view, save a
  variable as a file, rename, purge, create a directory, change the
  current one, set flags. This goes through the calculator's own Kermit
  server and leaves the stack and the screen as they were.
- **Keyboard shortcuts** (Alt+K): ON, α, the shifts and the app's
  actions can be bound to other keys.
- **Scripting**: `saturnus run --serve` serves the serial port for
  Kermit clients and a control API on 127.0.0.1; `saturnus ctl` drives
  it (`keys`, `screen`, `stack`, `type`, `text`, `store`, `fetch`, …).
  `saturnus ref` is a command reference with examples run on the
  emulator.

## The installers are not signed

They are built by this repository's `desktop.yml` workflow and not yet
signed with a developer certificate, so the operating system warns:

- **macOS**: open the `.dmg` and drag saturnus to Applications. On the
  first start macOS says the app "is damaged" or "cannot be opened".
  Run once, in Terminal:
  `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/saturnus.app`.
  (If the message offers it instead: System Settings, Privacy &
  Security, "Open Anyway".)
- **Windows**: SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC". Click
  "More info", then "Run anyway".
- **Linux**: packages are unsigned as usual.

## ROMs are not included

saturnus ships no ROM and never will. `saturnus rom fetch --model <m>`
downloads the images hpcalc.org offers for use with emulators (48SX ROM J,
48GX ROM R, 38G A1.67, 49G 2.15, 39G/40G) after asking, and checks size
and SHA-256; the web page and the app take the same files. The HP 42S ROM
was never released: dump your own calculator (see the README).

## Known limits

- The 38G, 39G, 40G and 42S have no reference emulator to compare
  screens against; the 42S runs at a flat, uncalibrated 1 MHz and its IR
  printer is not modelled.
- The memory view, the editor and the command reference cover the 48SX,
  48GX and 49G. On the 49G, writes other than flags need RPN mode (flag
  -95 clear).
- The speed calibration is fitted to one benchmark per model (48SX, 48GX,
  49G); the reason for the fitted factor is not known.
- The desktop app is built for Apple silicon Macs only (Intel Macs: use
  the web page or `cargo install saturnus-cli`) and has no auto-update.
- The control API listens on 127.0.0.1 only, behind a token.

## Clean room and AI notice

saturnus is written from public hardware documentation and the observed
behaviour of the calculators' own ROMs, not from the source code of other
emulators, and contains no HP logos or wordmarks. Parts of the code were
generated by AI systems under human supervision; see `AI_NOTICE`. MIT
licence.

See `CHANGELOG.md` for the full list.
